_comment: R4 of the on-app set (lib/carryScan/onApp.ts): the carry ROUTES shown on /carry (components/Carry/fixtures.ts ROUTES) carry display labels only.
Each label is keyed `<src> → <dst>` and resolves to the destination contract(s) a borrower's debt went to, read from the route-cohort seed
scripts/route-cohort/aug-2026-ab-vault-seed.json on origin/chore/data-capture-snapshot (72326cac). Position counts match the ROUTES `pos` field.
A label that is not one venue is an explicit waiver: it contributes no key, and the reason says why. tests/unit/carryScanDedupe.test.ts fails
when a ROUTES entry has neither.

USDT → Fluid.waiver: ambiguous: the seed splits this label between FluidBridgeAggregatorProxy 0x273da948aca9261043fbdb2a857bc255ecc29012 (15) and Fluid USD Coin 0x9fb7b4477576fe5b32be4c1843afb1e55f251b33 (3); the /carry row is a label, not a venue

USDC → Morpho Vault V2.waiver: not one venue: a class of 33 Morpho Vault V2 [USDC] vaults in the seed

USDC → Compound.waiver: unresolved: no Compound destination in the seed
